canonical_data: typed pipeline graphs, component state, documents, messages, tool calls, traces, and application-defined memory
strengths: Explicit pipelines, loops, branches, routing, retrieval, and agent steps make control flow inspectable
Lifecycle hooks, tool-call metrics, token accounting, evaluation, and tracing support production recovery
Broad provider, retrieval, storage, component, and deployment interoperability
weaknesses: Complex pipelines require more deliberate composition than higher-level opinionated agent APIs
Some serving, MCP, UI, and enterprise operations rely on adjacent Hayhooks or commercial products
Persistent memory and authorization policy remain application and integration concerns
why_it_matters: A mature reference for transparent, production-oriented orchestration where retrieval and agent control flow remain explicit.
